Lord God, we confess that so many times this week we have tried to present ourselves as
better than we are.
We try to fool the people around us, we try to fool ourselves, we try to fool you, all
the while missing the fact that we can't fool anybody least of all you and we don't need
to.
Oh Lord, teach us what it means that you are faithful in your love.
Teach us the depths of your love in the cross, that we might never again appeal to you
on the basis of anything other than you. Your word, your character, your promises,
what you have done in Jesus Christ.
O Lord, teach us where hope is truly found. Bring us to that hope.
And never let us go, we pray, for you are faithful.
You are our Father in Jesus Christ.
And so it is to you that we turn and depend.
In Christ's name, amen.
